datasets.name: ds_daily_revenue
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT trip_date, pickup_borough AS borough, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS daily_revenue, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, ROUND(AVG(tip_percentage), 2) AS avg_tip_pct FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 29 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY trip_date, pickup_borough ORDER BY trip_date DESC, daily_revenue DESC

datasets.name: ds_revenue_per_trip
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', trip_date) AS week_start, pickup_borough, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS revenue_per_trip, ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_distance FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 89 DAYS AND latest_date GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', trip_date), pickup_borough ORDER BY week_start DESC, pickup_borough

datasets.name: ds_anomaly_summary
queryLines: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(trip_date) AS latest_date FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary) SELECT trip_date, pickup_borough, anomaly_flag, COUNT(*) AS flagged_trips, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS flagged_revenue FROM nyc_taxi.gold.trip_summary CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE trip_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL 6 DAYS AND latest_date AND anomaly_flag != 'NORMAL' GROUP BY trip_date, pickup_borough, anomaly_flag ORDER BY trip_date DESC, flagged_trips DESC
